seed_strategy: One fixed bit sequence; each experiment has a fixed noise seed shared across both receiver branches and across its sweep; bootstrap streams are explicit and separate.

receiver_paths.baseline: same M2 matched filter + delay-aware sampling + existing BPSK detector
receiver_paths.candidate: offline filtfilt notch then same M2 receiver

statistical_methods.paired_difference: candidate minus baseline; contiguous 50-bit block bootstrap, 1000 replicates
statistical_methods.paired_test: exact two-sided McNemar test; independence assumption noted
